data.action: 提裙跨坐缓缓沉腰，遥控器抵胸如加冕，星瞳迷离
data.camera: cowboy shot, first-person view, low angle
data.description: 女王蜂把你按在椅子上，自己提着裙摆跨坐上来，黑金蕾丝内衣在台灯下泛着细碎的光。她抓起一只遥控器抵在你的胸口，像加冕一样缓缓沉腰——「本小姐的膝上……是限量席位哦♪ 只有今晚、只对你开放……那么，恳请女王赐予你奖赏吧。」
data.lighting: 台灯暖光与蕾丝黑金的诱惑光泽
data.promptProse: Misaki straddles the offscreen viewer in the armchair, one hand gathering her skirt, the other holding the remote against their chest. Warm table-lamp light catches the black-and-gold lace.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 女王的主控王座·「本小姐的膝上……是限量席位哦」
data.animaCaption: One hand gathers her skirt; the other holds the remote against the offscreen viewer's chest.
